htn_kidney.title: Ultrasound-guided percutaneous renal biopsy: Free-hand versus puncture attachment.
htn_kidney.journal: The Journal of international medical research
htn_kidney.authors: Lv Y, He G, Feng L
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究（样本量约为 110）。核心观点：目的超声引导下经皮肾活检是肾脏疾病的常用诊断手段。 临床提示：两名患者在显微镜下未见肾小球，无法诊断...
htn_kidney.abstract: ObjectiveUltrasound-guided percutaneous renal biopsy is a common diagnostic tool for renal disease. This study investigated the safety and efficiency of free-hand and puncture attachment approaches for ultrasound-guided percutaneous renal biopsy.MethodsThis retrospective, single-center study included 110 patients who underwent ultrasound-guided percutaneous renal biopsy. The patients were divided into the free-hand or puncture attachment group, depending on whether a puncture attachment was used.ResultsThe number of glomeruli obtained in the free-hand group was similar to that in the puncture attachment group. portal_hypertension.title: Three-Dimensional Portal Vein Geometry Predicts Post-TIPS -Hepatic Encephalopathy and Variceal Rebleeding: A Multicenter Study.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Wan S, Li J, Zhang X
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：TIPS 后明显肝性脑病 (OHE) 和静脉曲张再出血 (VRB) 仍然是严重的并发症，预测工具有限。 临床提示：本研究探讨了术前固有的三维门静脉几何形状 (3D-PVG) 是否可以作为接受经颈静脉肝内肝移植的患者 1 年 OHE 和 VRB 的独立预后生物标志物
portal_hypertension.abstract: Post-TIPS overt hepatic encephalopathy (OHE) and variceal rebleeding (VRB) remain serious complications with limited predictive tools. This study investigates whether the inherent preoperative three-dimensional portal venous geometry (3D-PVG) serves as an independent prognostic biomarker for 1year OHE and VRB in patients undergoing transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS). In this multicenter retrospective study, 579 cirrhotic patients undergoing successful TIPS were enrolled. We extracted 3D-PVG features from routine computed tomography angiography (CTA) images before TIPS, quantifying bifurcation angles ('Near') and vessel segment tortuosity ('Far'). portal_hypertension.title: Impact of Breath Holding on Spleen Stiffness Measured by 100 Hz Vibration Controlled Transient Elastography.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Atzori S, Meloni P, Arru M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：基于超声的脾硬度测量 (SSM) 是评估慢性肝病门脉高压 (PH) 的有效非侵入性工具。 临床提示：尽管呼吸相在肝脏硬度测量过程中的作用已经确定，但没有研究专门探讨呼吸如何通过瞬态弹性成像影响 SSM。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Ultrasound-based spleen stiffness measurement (SSM) is a valid non-invasive tool to assess portal hypertension (PH) in chronic liver disease. Whereas the role of the respiratory phase during liver stiffness measurements is established, no study has specifically addressed how respiration influences SSM by transient elastography. To evaluate the influence of respiration on SSM assessed with FibroScan 630 (Echosens, Paris, France). Eighty-three patients with chronic liver disease of different aetiologies underwent SSM using vibration-controlled transient elastography (VCTE).
